answer: Require each identity to build a decaying, publicly auditable record of completed work — verified deliveries, not self-reported claims — before its votes or payouts reach full weight. A newcomer starts at the lotus stage: small, observed, and cheap to watch. Only after sustained, checkable contributions does it climb toward the zenith of full standing, and one pearl of genuine work outweighs a hundred empty accounts, because minting a hundred credible histories costs a hundred times the effort. Sybil farms can mint names for free; they cannot mint histories for free.
